column4: Intelligent support hub, base 375 board — RE-MEASURED LIVE off its own card run 14178:144069 and FIXED (commit 966b57576). Matching after the fix: content column 343 at x=16 (was 311 under a flat px-8); grid TWO columns of 168 on an 8 gutter (card at x=0, x=176); card pitch preview 168x70 + 2 + label 167.5x70 = 142; label pane inner 143.5x46 at (12,12) with a 40x40 tile carrying a 16 glyph at y=3, a 10 gap, a 93.5 text column, title box 18 tall at y=0 and the tier block at y=22 as a 24px icons/tiers at x=0 with the word at x=28; top inset 16 under the 48 header. NOT matching, deliberately: the tier WORDS (frame says Gold on four of five cards, SCREEN_TIERS — the map ScreenGate reads — says bronze/silver/bronze/silver/bronze; a badge is an entitlement claim) and the preview pane (both hub variants bake fabricated numbers into it, so it ships as the frame's Green Coal 100 wash carrying the destination glyph).

Intelligent support hub, ALT 2 375 board — READ LIVE and it CONTRADICTS the base 375 board 14178-151580 at the same width, so neither side was built. Matching: content column 343 at (16,64); hero 343x144 = title 30 at y=0, subtitle 36 at y=40, search input 343x44 at y=100; Models row 36 high with a 22-high label at y=7. Departing: this board's Frame 1000003854 stacks ONE 343-wide, 209-tall card per position (rows at y=0/434/868, cards at y=0 and y=217 within each) where the base board puts two 168-wide cards side by side; and its Models header carries two 36x36 CTAs at x=261 and x=307 (14316:255759 / :255760) the base board does not draw. DECISION: which 375 board governs the hub.

Sentiment 'View all topics' overlay — READ LIVE (get_metadata on the frame, get_design_context on 13436:181796 and 13436:181811) and BUILT (commit fba761d5e). Matching: 680-wide card over the dimmed board; header Frame 299 680x52, 24px top corners, 16 side inset, 4 top pad, bottom menu padding 8/6 round a 34-high row; tab strip on a 24 gutter, Manrope 14/18 tracking -0.04em, open tab white over a 28px rule on the header's bottom edge, rest #95A09F; post band px16/py4 with a 75-wide left column (24-wide Mulish 12/16 rank, 32px r8 tile, 24px circle, 10 apart) beside a 1px #123F3C card r8 p16 gap8; head row 24 avatar + Manrope Bold 12/16 handle against Mulish 12/16 white @64% time, #56C7F3 'Jump to post' and two 16px glyphs on an 8 gutter; 1px row rules; 54-high pager. NOT matching, and it cannot: no posts source exists — social_posts has no migration, getSocialPosts filters an always-empty in-memory stream, fetchAssetSentiment returns topBullishPosts/topBearishPosts as [] — so the body renders its explicit empty state and the tab strip derives its tabs from the platforms real posts carry rather than the frame's Skai/Instagram/X/Facebook, which SocialPlatform has no members for.
